introHtml: Metal webcam covers offer a more durable and premium alternative to plastic or adhesive versions. Ideal for corporate offices, schools, and government facilities, these covers slide easily over laptop or monitor cameras to block unauthorized viewing. Choose from brushed aluminum, stainless steel, or anodized finishes, then add your logo via laser engraving or pad printing for a polished, long-lasting brand impression. They are thin enough to allow laptop lids to close fully, making them a practical security accessory for any workplace.
